spark.scene: True-color view of the main Hawaiian Islands with Niihau/Kauai upper left to Hawaii Island lower right. Scattered bright white cumulus and cirrus clouds over ocean and islands with a large cloudy area to the north and curved white lee clouds southwest of Hawaii Island. Dark ocean is clear in the central area. No distinct gray, brown, or off-white haze or smoke streak clearly separate from ordinary clouds is visible.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: Minor new eruptive activity began near the base of the northwest wall of Halemaʻumaʻu crater last night. Spattering continues from the north vent along with periodic bursts from the south vent. Summit inflation stalled with opening of the new vent.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts increased in August, while the summit region showed no other signs of deformation. Mauna Loa had an increase in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 87 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the August reporting period, after 57 in July. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
